messages:
sara: heads-up — ACME complaining that text.generate p99 jumped to ~3.2s starting ~14:03 UTC. Datadog graph: https://datadog.fake/redwood/...
alerts-bot: [ALERT] continuous_batcher.p99 > 1500ms (3.2s) for model rdx-1-large in pool eu-west-1 — triggered 14:04:12 UTC
chao: which tenant? can you paste the request example and recent batcher config?
sara: tenant acme-inc. Repro curl below, happens frequently with many tiny prompts (~12-30 tokens).

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -d '{"model":"rdx-1-large","inputs":["hi","status?","ok","please summarize"]}'
```

sara: note we rolled batcher config at 1774990000 — changed default hold_window_ms from 8 -> 24 for better throughput.
leo: pattern: lots of tiny independent requests plus periodic auth token refreshes. continuous_batcher hold_window is now long so coalescing waits for more msgs, but when auth refreshes stall a few requests, the whole batch waits -> tail blowup.
olivia: digging into metrics: coalesce.wait_ms histogram has a new heavy tail >150ms; kv_cache_miss_rate for acme spiked 4x; auth_refresh.latency p95 went from 60ms -> 1.6s.

sara: here's a quick log snippet showing the hold timer tied to a request that later stalls on auth refresh:

```text
[14:03:21.123] batcher: created batch id=bn-123 hold_deadline=24ms size=1
[14:03:21.145] request=acme-req-42 auth: token refresh start
[14:03:22.780] auth: refresh done (1.63s) -> request unblocked -> batch executes -> p99 spike
```

chao: mitigation proposal (hotfix): 1) lower hold_window_ms to 6 for acme's routing rule; 2) enable prefer_small_batch=true so tiny requests are forwarded immediately; 3) add an auth latency threshold to batcher heuristic so requests waiting on auth don't block the rest.

chao: quick admin API patch (hotfix):
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://control.redwood.ai/admin/v1/pools/eu-west-1/config \
 -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\" \
 -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
 -d '{"routing_rules": [{"tenant":"acme-inc","hold_window_ms":6,"prefer_small_batch":true}]}'
```

sara: applied routing patch at 14:08 UTC, monitoring.
alerts-bot: [RESOLVED] continuous_batcher.p99 for rdx-1-large in eu-west-1 back to baseline (p99=180ms) — cleared 14:12 UTC
product-bot: customer impact? should we proactively notify ACME or wait for follow-up? :thinking_face:

sara: brief: large-scale slowdown affected ~1200 requests over 9 minutes, p99 spiked to 3.2s, we applied hotfix and p99 returned to ~180ms. I'll send a post-fix note and offer a dedicated pool.
leo: follow-ups: (1) add auth-wait detection to batcher (owner: chao), issue #SRE-812 (2) add telemetry: per-request wait_reason tag (owner: olivia) (3) consider per-tenant small-request fastpath and rate-limits for token refresh storms (owner: leo)
chao: opening SRE ticket now and adding repro script + synthetic test for tiny prompts + simulated auth stalls.

sara: draft to ACME done, will send in 30m. marking this thread resolved for now, leaving follow-ups in tracker.
olivia: adding dashboards: continuous_batcher.wait_ms by tenant + auth_refresh.latency by tenant + coalesce_batch_size distribution.

sara: thanks all :thumbsup:
